job.title: Dispatcher
job.description: Plans the drivers' routes between Winnipeg and Thunder Bay, tracks the loads and answers the drivers on the radio.

probation.conditions: a review with the dispatch manager at the end of the period

qualifications: Two years of dispatch experience and a working knowledge of hours-of-service rules for commercial drivers
training: Two weeks of training on the dispatch software at the start, paid and at the employer's cost

hours.standard: 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 16:30 with a 30-minute unpaid break
hours.overtime: hours beyond 8 in a day or 40 in a week are overtime and are worked only when the dispatch manager asks (Canada Labour Code ss. 169 and 174)

pay.other_pay: a yearly bonus, if any, is paid in March
pay.method: direct deposit to the employee's bank account

deductions: Income tax, Canada Pension Plan contributions and Employment Insurance premiums
expenses: Claim work-related expenses on the expense form with the receipts; approved claims are repaid with the next pay
